items.heading: Feijoada
details: Key ingredients: black beans, pork cuts, beef, bay leaf, garlic, onion
Soak black beans, then simmer with assorted pork and beef cuts.
Add bay leaf, garlic and onion, cooking slowly for a few hours.
Skim fat and adjust seasoning as the stew thickens.
Serve with rice, collard greens and orange slices.

items.heading: Brigadeiro
details: Key ingredients: condensed milk, cocoa powder, butter, chocolate sprinkles
Cook condensed milk, cocoa powder and butter over low heat, stirring constantly.
Continue until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the pan.
Cool, then roll into small balls.
Coat each ball in chocolate sprinkles before serving.

items.heading: Pao de Queijo
details: Key ingredients: tapioca starch, cheese, milk, oil, eggs
Scald milk and oil together, then mix into tapioca starch.
Knead in eggs and grated cheese until a sticky dough forms.
Roll into small balls and place on a baking tray.
Bake until puffed and golden with a chewy interior.
